test_get_debug_level_environment_variabl: test that get_debug_level reads the COMPILER_GYM_DEBUG environment variable correctly
test_get_and_set_debug_level: test that set_debug_level and get_debug_level work together to set and retrieve debug levels
test_negative_debug_level: test that setting a negative debug level clamps to zero
test_out_of_range_debug_level: test that setting a high debug level like 15 is accepted without clamping
test_get_logging_level: test that get_logging_level maps debug levels 0-4 to ERROR, WARNING, INFO, and DEBUG
